svg.title: Architecture: two isolated stacks, each with an OCM hub running SSP, Flux and SPIRE; build, observability, team and shared clusters connect outbound; Git is the only link
svg.text: np-hub · OCM hub, Cluster API and SSP (created once)
Only Flux writes desired state · teams may also write their app-* namespace
klusterlet and add-on agents connect outbound to the hub (SPIFFE identity)
All of these are provisioned by SSP from KubernetesCluster requests (SR-1, SR-8)
pr-hub · OCM hub, Cluster API and SSP (created once)
Only Flux writes desired state · people read only (SR-9)
klusterlet and add-on agents connect outbound to the hub (SPIFFE identity)
All of these are provisioned by SSP from KubernetesCluster requests (SR-1, SR-8)
Every arrow into a stack is a pull: Flux fetches Git, and agents connect out to their own hub.
SSP provisions every cluster except the hub: Cluster API creates it, OCM imports it, add-ons follow.
